survey_name: Google Photos Vague-Memory Search & Urgency Behavioral Survey
survey_description: 15-question primary research survey investigating vague memory search behavior, search urgency triggers, scroll fatigue thresholds, and anchor memory recall patterns.

questions.text: 2. Which city do you live in?
4. Roughly how many photos and videos are in your gallery?
5. How often do you search for old or specific photos?
6. When searching for a vague memory, what is your primary urgency?
7. When searching for a blurry memory, what is your VERY FIRST action?
8. Think of a recent search: What exact vague words did you type into the search bar?
9. What actual photo or document were you trying to retrieve?
10. If your first search fails, what do you try next?
11. When your vague memory is unclear, what surrounding detail do you remember best?
12. How long do you scroll or modify searches before completely giving up?
13. What happened when you attempted that search?
14. In your opinion, why was the target photo impossible to find?
15. Would tapping a known landmark photo to jump to a 4-hour time window help?
